definitions: To do something in a mechanical or unenthusiastic way, without genuine interest or effort.
To perform a task or duty perfunctorily, without engaging fully or caring about the outcome.
examples: He's just going through the motions at work; his heart isn't in it anymore.
She went through the motions of studying, but she wasn't really absorbing anything.
The team was clearly going through the motions after falling so far behind.
